title: "Supp. Fig. 3E/F - WT pTyr, Pav, and Vsg quantification"
output: null
date: "2026-04-29"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggprism)
source("analysis_helpers.R")
```

```{r}
# Supp. Fig. 3E/F: load WT pTyr/Pav/Vsg ring canal counts.

data_file <- "../Data/SuppFig3E_F_WT_pTyr_Pav_Vsg_quantification.csv"
category_output_file <- "../Results/SuppFig 3E.pdf"
output_file <- "../Results/SuppFig3F_WT_pTyr_among_Vsg_RCs.pdf"

ptyr_quantification_raw <- read_analysis_csv(data_file)
```

```{r}
# Supp. Fig. 3E: calculate category percentages by replicate for the stacked
# ring canal composition plot.

ptyr_quantification <- ptyr_quantification_raw %>%
  group_by(Genotype, Replicate, Category) %>%
  summarise(
    Positive_Structures = mean(Positive_Structures, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop_last"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Genotype, Replicate) %>%
  mutate(Percent = 100 * Positive_Structures / sum(Positive_Structures)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# Supp. Fig. 3E: plot all pTyr/Pav/Vsg category percentages by replicate.

ggplot(ptyr_quantification, aes(x = Replicate, y = Percent, fill = Category)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Percentage") 

ggsave(category_output_file)
```

```{r}
# Supp. Fig. 3F: helper for pairwise denominators used to ask what fraction of
# Vsg+ structures are pTyr+ with or without Pav.

vsg_only_comparison <- ptyr_quantification_raw %>%
    filter(Category %in% c("ptyr_vsg", "vsg")) %>%
    group_by(Replicate, Category) %>%
    summarise(n = sum(Positive_Structures), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Replicate) %>%
    mutate(Percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
    ungroup()


summarize_mean_sd(vsg_only_comparison, group_cols = "Category", value_col = Percent)
```

```{r}
# Supp. Fig. 3F: calculate pTyr+ fraction among Pav+, Vsg+ structures.
pav_vsg_comparison <- ptyr_quantification_raw %>%
    filter(Category %in% c("pav_vsg", "ptyr_pav_vsg")) %>%
    group_by(Replicate, Category) %>%
    summarise(n = sum(Positive_Structures), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Replicate) %>%
    mutate(Percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
    ungroup()

summarize_mean_sd(pav_vsg_comparison, group_cols = "Category", value_col = Percent)
```

```{r}
# Supp. Fig. 3F: combine the pairwise comparisons for plotting.

ptyr_vsg <- bind_rows(vsg_only_comparison, pav_vsg_comparison) %>%
  mutate(
    Category = factor(
      Category,
      levels = c("vsg", "ptyr_vsg", "pav_vsg", "ptyr_pav_vsg")
    )
  )
ptyr_vsg
```



```{r}
# Supp. Fig. 3F: plot pTyr+ percentages among Pav-, Vsg+ and Pav+, Vsg+ rings.

ptyr_positive_plot_data <- ptyr_vsg %>%
  filter(Category %in% c("ptyr_vsg", "ptyr_pav_vsg")) %>%
  mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels = c("ptyr_vsg", "pav_vsg")))

plot_box_jitter(
  data = ptyr_positive_plot_data,
  x = Category,
  y = Percent,
  y_labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1),
  plot_title = "Percent that are pTyr+",
  y_limits = c(0, 100),
  x_labels = c("Pav-, Vsg+", "Pav+, Vsg+"),
  box_fill = "grey"
)

ggsave(output_file, width = 2, height = 2.5, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
```
